Name: APF - Animated Portrait Framework
Author: Tyr4nTX
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Animated Portrait Framework[/u][/size][/b]

[size=4]
SMAPI mod that brings NPC portraits to life with frame-based sprite animations. Supports unlimited expressions, multiple animation modes (loop, pingpong, once), automatic DDF integration, and per-expression spritesheets. Modders create simple JSON content packs — no coding required.

[color=#ff0000][u]Requires Dialogue Display Framework Continued.[/u][/color][/size]


[size=4][u]APF Portrait Studio

[/u][/size]Browser-based tool for creating APF content packs. Cut video clips into sprite frames, remove backgrounds with AI (rembg), clean up artifacts, fill holes, preview animations in real-time, and export ready-to-use content packs with one click. Runs locally via Flask — no uploads, no cloud.

1. It seems complicated BUT there is a TOUR guide! 
2. If you want to create a NORMAL Replacer and not animated [b][color=#00ff00]YOU can......!    Just Put your Expression.png in the Video Cutter and make the Video on 1 Frames and 1 FPS and will create a normal Replacer[/color]
[/b]3. [b]BUT this Tool is basicly for animations! 

[color=#ff0000][u]IMPORTANT/Requirements:[/u]

1. FFMPEG FULL BUILD: 
https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg

2. RemBG:
https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg

3. DDFC (Dialogue Display Framework Continued)[/color]



My Workflow:

1. Create a Character ( AI because i can t draw) or Draw something [color=#ff0000][size=4](IMPORTANT: Make the Background ALWAYS black)[/size][/color]

2. Use grok imagine and drop your Character make a 6 seconds video! (Its free) 

3. Drop this 6 sec Video in the DEV cutter and cut your animation as your desire (I always use 1024x1024, BUT in Export i resized to 512x512 so its smaller and you don t see a diffrent in SDV trust me i testet it.

4. run the Background Remover remove the background to get a transparent Sheet

5. Export: Make a zip to drop it in Vortex, or just deploy the mod in your Mod Folder directly! 


IMPORTANT: Its an ALPHA Version ! 

NEXT STEP: I Want to create a easy CP within this tool so you can create a CUSTOM Expression and make a content pack, when and how this Expression is triggered... ! 


Have fun creating! and Please tell me everything thats not working! 

English is not my native language so sorry for bad spelling! [/b]
